operation.candidate: Execute one existing authored audio control on a live emitter.
operation.script_result: No Lua return value or playing ID.
operation.hash: Seed 0x811c9dc5; sign-extend each string byte, OR 0x20, XOR accumulator, multiply 0x1000193 modulo 2^32; zero is rejected.
operation.semantic_limit: A control ID is an authored event/control selector, not an audio filename or arbitrary resource handle.

fields.0x00: backend object identity, u64; stream-out writes all-ones sentinel

control_consumption: 0x32f5120 skips processing for AudioDisabled; an optional WwiseEventControlComponent has a separate stateful branch through 0x32f4e00.
The definitions branch compares control hash with record +0x18. Hash 0x13254bc4 bypasses this equality check and applies to every definition; its string spelling is unresolved.
For each match it removes callback bookkeeping and stops existing tracked IDs, clears their count, then posts record +0x1c if nonzero.
Only a nonzero backend result is added to the definition playing-ID list. An unknown control match or unresolved zero event produces no new instance.
0x33e6d70 includes a context-local event-ID suppression list: a matching ID returns zero without posting. Exact lifetime/intent of that list remains unresolved.

resources.stream_in: 0x32f3930 resolves both a default event and each named definition.
resources.failure: Invalid/sentinel reference or missing acquired resource returns zero.
resources.limit: Resource type descriptor, bank dependencies and custom resource registration are not recovered by this map.

input: numeric fade duration, converted to float then multiplied by 1000 and truncated to integer backend duration
stop.duration_interpretation: Seconds-to-milliseconds is strongly supported by the conversion; backend duration units are not independently gameplay-measured.
stop.cleanup: Both immediate and faded stop also remove the ID from engine bookkeeping through 0x33e7150.
stop.ownership_limit: A raw playing ID has no mod ownership or generation boundary; it must not become an unrestricted Wasm parameter.

lifetime: Emitter stream-out 0x32f4380 gathers playing IDs, appends them to GameObjectCleanup +0x10, requests backend object stop, appends backend object ID to GameObjectCleanup +0, and invalidates ActiveGameObject +0.
Later cleanup 0x32f3350 removes accumulated playing-ID bookkeeping, then retires queued backend objects through 0x33e5ae0; both queue counts are cleared.
Stop submission and backend object retirement are distinct. Stream-out is not evidence that the backend command has already finished or that an ECS handle remains usable.
remaining_gaps: Actual order/thread affinity of Lua appends, queue handoff, event consumption and stream-out; the Lua append uses no visible locking and writes the active buffer directly.
